NASB.1: Then the LORD spoke to Moses, saying,
NASB.2: 'Tell the sons of Israel to raise a contribution for Me; from every man whose heart moves him you shall raise My contribution.
NASB.3: 'This is the contribution which you are to raise from them: gold, silver and bronze,
NASB.4: blue, purple and scarlet [material], fine linen, goat [hair],
NASB.5: rams' skins dyed red, porpoise skins, acacia wood,
NASB.6: oil for lighting, spices for the anointing oil and for the fragrant incense,
NASB.7: onyx stones and setting stones for the ephod and for the breastpiece.
NASB.8: 'Let them construct a sanctuary for Me, that I may dwell among them.
NASB.9: 'According to all that I am going to show you, [as] the pattern of the tabernacle and the pattern of all its furniture, just so you shall construct [it].
NASB.10: 'They shall construct an ark of acacia wood two and a half cubits long, and one and a half cubits wide, and one and a half cubits high.
NASB.11: 'You shall overlay it with pure gold, inside and out you shall overlay it, and you shall make a gold molding around it.
NASB.12: 'You shall cast four gold rings for it and fasten them on its four feet, and two rings shall be on one side of it and two rings on the other side of it.
NASB.13: 'You shall make poles of acacia wood and overlay them with gold.
NASB.14: 'You shall put the poles into the rings on the sides of the ark, to carry the ark with them.
NASB.15: 'The poles shall remain in the rings of the ark; they shall not be removed from it.
NASB.16: 'You shall put into the ark the testimony which I shall give you.
NASB.17: 'You shall make a mercy seat of pure gold, two and a half cubits long and one and a half cubits wide.
NASB.18: 'You shall make two cherubim of gold, make them of hammered work at the two ends of the mercy seat.
NASB.19: 'Make one cherub at one end and one cherub at the other end; you shall make the cherubim [of one piece] with the mercy seat at its two ends.
NASB.20: 'The cherubim shall have [their] wings spread upward, covering the mercy seat with their wings and facing one another; the faces of the cherubim are to be [turned] toward the mercy seat.
NASB.21: 'You shall put the mercy seat on top of the ark, and in the ark you shall put the testimony which I will give to you.
NASB.22: 'There I will meet with you; and from above the mercy seat, from between the two cherubim which are upon the ark of the testimony, I will speak to you about all that I will give you in commandment for the sons of Israel.
NASB.23: 'You shall make a table of acacia wood, two cubits long and one cubit wide and one and a half cubits high.
NASB.24: 'You shall overlay it with pure gold and make a gold border around it.
NASB.25: 'You shall make for it a rim of a handbreadth around [it]; and you shall make a gold border for the rim around it.
NASB.26: 'You shall make four gold rings for it and put rings on the four corners which are on its four feet.
NASB.27: 'The rings shall be close to the rim as holders for the poles to carry the table.
NASB.28: 'You shall make the poles of acacia wood and overlay them with gold, so that with them the table may be carried.
NASB.29: 'You shall make its dishes and its pans and its jars and its bowls with which to pour drink offerings; you shall make them of pure gold.
NASB.30: 'You shall set the bread of the Presence on the table before Me at all times.
NASB.31: 'Then you shall make a lampstand of pure gold. The lampstand [and] its base and its shaft are to be made of hammered work; its cups, its bulbs and its flowers shall be [of one piece] with it.
NASB.32: 'Six branches shall go out from its sides; three branches of the lampstand from its one side and three branches of the lampstand from its other side.
NASB.33: 'Three cups [shall be] shaped like almond [blossoms] in the one branch, a bulb and a flower, and three cups shaped like almond [blossoms] in the other branch, a bulb and a flower-- so for six branches going out from the lampstand;
NASB.34: and in the lampstand four cups shaped like almond [blossoms], its bulbs and its flowers.
NASB.35: 'A bulb shall be under the [first] pair of branches [coming] out of it, and a bulb under the [second] pair of branches [coming] out of it, and a bulb under the [third] pair of branches [coming] out of it, for the six branches coming out of the lampstand.
NASB.36: 'Their bulbs and their branches [shall be of one piece] with it; all of it shall be one piece of hammered work of pure gold.
NASB.37: 'Then you shall make its lamps seven [in number]; and they shall mount its lamps so as to shed light on the space in front of it.
NASB.38: 'Its snuffers and their trays [shall be] of pure gold.
NASB.39: 'It shall be made from a talent of pure gold, with all these utensils.
NASB.40: 'See that you make [them] after the pattern for them, which was shown to you on the mountain.

ESV.2: “Speak to the people of Israel, that they take for me a contribution. From every man whose heart moves him you shall receive the contribution for me.
ESV.3: And this is the contribution that you shall receive from them: gold, silver, and bronze,
ESV.4: blue and purple and scarlet yarns and fine twined linen, goats' hair,
ESV.5: tanned rams' skins, goatskins,  acacia wood,
ESV.6: oil for the lamps, spices for the anointing oil and for the fragrant incense,
ESV.7: onyx stones, and stones for setting, for the ephod and for the breastpiece.
ESV.8: And let them make me a sanctuary, that I may dwell in their midst.
ESV.9: Exactly as I show you concerning the pattern of the tabernacle, and of all its furniture, so you shall make it.
ESV.10: “They shall make an ark of acacia wood. Two cubits  and a half shall be its length, a cubit and a half its breadth, and a cubit and a half its height.
ESV.11: You shall overlay it with pure gold, inside and outside shall you overlay it, and you shall make on it a molding of gold around it.
ESV.12: You shall cast four rings of gold for it and put them on its four feet, two rings on the one side of it, and two rings on the other side of it.
ESV.13: You shall make poles of acacia wood and overlay them with gold.
ESV.14: And you shall put the poles into the rings on the sides of the ark to carry the ark by them.
ESV.15: The poles shall remain in the rings of the ark; they shall not be taken from it.
ESV.16: And you shall put into the ark the testimony that I shall give you.
ESV.17: “You shall make a mercy seat  of pure gold. Two cubits and a half shall be its length, and a cubit and a half its breadth.
ESV.18: And you shall make two cherubim of gold; of hammered work shall you make them, on the two ends of the mercy seat.
ESV.19: Make one cherub on the one end, and one cherub on the other end. Of one piece with the mercy seat shall you make the cherubim on its two ends.
ESV.20: The cherubim shall spread out their wings above, overshadowing the mercy seat with their wings, their faces one to another; toward the mercy seat shall the faces of the cherubim be.
ESV.21: And you shall put the mercy seat on the top of the ark, and in the ark you shall put the testimony that I shall give you.
ESV.22: There I will meet with you, and from above the mercy seat, from between the two cherubim that are on the ark of the testimony, I will speak with you about all that I will give you in commandment for the people of Israel.
ESV.23: “You shall make a table of acacia wood. Two cubits shall be its length, a cubit its breadth, and a cubit and a half its height.
ESV.24: You shall overlay it with pure gold and make a molding of gold around it.
ESV.25: And you shall make a rim around it a handbreadth  wide, and a molding of gold around the rim.
ESV.26: And you shall make for it four rings of gold, and fasten the rings to the four corners at its four legs.
ESV.27: Close to the frame the rings shall lie, as holders for the poles to carry the table.
ESV.28: You shall make the poles of acacia wood, and overlay them with gold, and the table shall be carried with these.
ESV.29: And you shall make its plates and dishes for incense, and its flagons and bowls with which to pour drink offerings; you shall make them of pure gold.
ESV.30: And you shall set the bread of the Presence on the table before me regularly.
ESV.31: “You shall make a lampstand of pure gold. The lampstand shall be made of hammered work: its base, its stem, its cups, its calyxes, and its flowers shall be of one piece with it.
ESV.32: And there shall be six branches going out of its sides, three branches of the lampstand out of one side of it and three branches of the lampstand out of the other side of it;
ESV.33: three cups made like almond blossoms, each with calyx and flower, on one branch, and three cups made like almond blossoms, each with calyx and flower, on the other branch — so for the six branches going out of the lampstand.
ESV.34: And on the lampstand itself there shall be four cups made like almond blossoms, with their calyxes and flowers,
ESV.35: and a calyx of one piece with it under each pair of the six branches going out from the lampstand.
ESV.36: Their calyxes and their branches shall be of one piece with it, the whole of it a single piece of hammered work of pure gold.
ESV.37: You shall make seven lamps for it. And the lamps shall be set up so as to give light on the space in front of it.
ESV.38: Its tongs and their trays shall be of pure gold.
ESV.39: It shall be made, with all these utensils, out of a talent  of pure gold.
ESV.40: And see that you make them after the pattern for them, which is being shown you on the mountain.

NKJV.1: Then the LORD spoke to Moses, saying:
NKJV.2: “Speak to the children of Israel, that they bring Me an offering. From everyone who gives it willingly with his heart you shall take My offering.
NKJV.3: And this is the offering which you shall take from them: gold, silver, and bronze;
NKJV.4: blue, purple, and scarlet thread, fine linen, and goats’ hair;
NKJV.5: ram skins dyed red, badger skins, and acacia wood;
NKJV.6: oil for the light, and spices for the anointing oil and for the sweet incense;
NKJV.7: onyx stones, and stones to be set in the ephod and in the breastplate.
NKJV.8: And let them make Me a sanctuary, that I may dwell among them.
NKJV.9: According to all that I show you, that is, the pattern of the tabernacle and the pattern of all its furnishings, just so you shall make it.
NKJV.10: “And they shall make an ark of acacia wood; two and a half cubits shall be its length, a cubit and a half its width, and a cubit and a half its height.
NKJV.11: And you shall overlay it with pure gold, inside and out you shall overlay it, and shall make on it a molding of gold all around.
NKJV.12: You shall cast four rings of gold for it, and put them in its four corners; two rings shall be on one side, and two rings on the other side.
NKJV.13: And you shall make poles of acacia wood, and overlay them with gold.
NKJV.14: You shall put the poles into the rings on the sides of the ark, that the ark may be carried by them.
NKJV.15: The poles shall be in the rings of the ark; they shall not be taken from it.
NKJV.16: And you shall put into the ark the Testimony which I will give you.
NKJV.17: “You shall make a mercy seat of pure gold; two and a half cubits shall be its length and a cubit and a half its width.
NKJV.18: And you shall make two cherubim of gold; of hammered work you shall make them at the two ends of the mercy seat.
NKJV.19: Make one cherub at one end, and the other cherub at the other end; you shall make the cherubim at the two ends of it of one piece with the mercy seat.
NKJV.20: And the cherubim shall stretch out their wings above, covering the mercy seat with their wings, and they shall face one another; the faces of the cherubim shall be toward the mercy seat.
NKJV.21: You shall put the mercy seat on top of the ark, and in the ark you shall put the Testimony that I will give you.
NKJV.22: And there I will meet with you, and I will speak with you from above the mercy seat, from between the two cherubim which are on the ark of the Testimony, about everything which I will give you in commandment to the children of Israel.
NKJV.23: “You shall also make a table of acacia wood; two cubits shall be its length, a cubit its width, and a cubit and a half its height.
NKJV.24: And you shall overlay it with pure gold, and make a molding of gold all around.
NKJV.25: You shall make for it a frame of a handbreadth all around, and you shall make a gold molding for the frame all around.
NKJV.26: And you shall make for it four rings of gold, and put the rings on the four corners that are at its four legs.
NKJV.27: The rings shall be close to the frame, as holders for the poles to bear the table.
NKJV.28: And you shall make the poles of acacia wood, and overlay them with gold, that the table may be carried with them.
NKJV.29: You shall make its dishes, its pans, its pitchers, and its bowls for pouring. You shall make them of pure gold.
NKJV.30: And you shall set the showbread on the table before Me always.
NKJV.31: “You shall also make a lampstand of pure gold; the lampstand shall be of hammered work. Its shaft, its branches, its bowls, its ornamental knobs, and flowers shall be of one piece.
NKJV.32: And six branches shall come out of its sides: three branches of the lampstand out of one side, and three branches of the lampstand out of the other side.
NKJV.33: Three bowls shall be made like almond blossoms on one branch, with an ornamental knob and a flower, and three bowls made like almond blossoms on the other branch, with an ornamental knob and a flower—and so for the six branches that come out of the lampstand.
NKJV.34: On the lampstand itself four bowls shall be made like almond blossoms, each with its ornamental knob and flower.

NKJV.36: Their knobs and their branches shall be of one piece; all of it shall be one hammered piece of pure gold.

NKJV.38: And its wick-trimmers and their trays shall be of pure gold.

WEB.2: “Speak to the children of Israel, that they take an offering for me. From everyone whose heart makes him willing you shall take my offering.
WEB.3: This is the offering which you shall take from them: gold, silver, brass,
WEB.4: blue, purple, scarlet, fine linen, goats’ hair,
WEB.5: rams’ skins dyed red, sea cow hides, acacia wood,
WEB.6: oil for the light, spices for the anointing oil and for the sweet incense,
WEB.7: onyx stones, and stones to be set for the ephod and for the breastplate.
WEB.8: Let them make me a sanctuary, that I may dwell among them.
WEB.9: According to all that I show you, the pattern of the tabernacle, and the pattern of all of its furniture, even so you shall make it.
WEB.10: “They shall make an ark of acacia wood. Its length shall be two and a half cubits,  its width a cubit and a half, and a cubit and a half its height.
WEB.11: You shall overlay it with pure gold. You shall overlay it inside and outside, and you shall make a gold molding around it.
WEB.12: You shall cast four rings of gold for it, and put them in its four feet. Two rings shall be on the one side of it, and two rings on the other side of it.
WEB.13: You shall make poles of acacia wood, and overlay them with gold.
WEB.14: You shall put the poles into the rings on the sides of the ark to carry the ark.
WEB.15: The poles shall be in the rings of the ark. They shall not be taken from it.
WEB.16: You shall put the testimony which I shall give you into the ark.
WEB.17: You shall make a mercy seat of pure gold. Two and a half cubits shall be its length, and a cubit and a half its width.
WEB.18: You shall make two cherubim of hammered gold. You shall make them at the two ends of the mercy seat.
WEB.19: Make one cherub at the one end, and one cherub at the other end. You shall make the cherubim on its two ends of one piece with the mercy seat.
WEB.20: The cherubim shall spread out their wings upward, covering the mercy seat with their wings, with their faces toward one another. The faces of the cherubim shall be toward the mercy seat.
WEB.21: You shall put the mercy seat on top of the ark, and in the ark you shall put the testimony that I will give you.
WEB.22: There I will meet with you, and I will tell you from above the mercy seat, from between the two cherubim which are on the ark of the testimony, all that I command you for the children of Israel.
WEB.23: “You shall make a table of acacia wood. Two cubits shall be its length, and a cubit its width, and one and a half cubits its height.
WEB.24: You shall overlay it with pure gold, and make a gold molding around it.
WEB.25: You shall make a rim of a hand width around it. You shall make a golden molding on its rim around it.
WEB.26: You shall make four rings of gold for it, and put the rings in the four corners that are on its four feet.
WEB.27: the rings shall be close to the rim, for places for the poles to carry the table.
WEB.28: You shall make the poles of acacia wood, and overlay them with gold, that the table may be carried with them.
WEB.29: You shall make its dishes, its spoons, its ladles, and its bowls to pour out offerings with. You shall make them of pure gold.
WEB.30: You shall set bread of the presence on the table before me always.
WEB.31: “You shall make a lamp stand of pure gold. Of hammered work shall the lamp stand be made, even its base, its shaft, its cups, its buds, and its flowers, shall be of one piece with it.
WEB.32: There shall be six branches going out of its sides: three branches of the lamp stand out of its one side, and three branches of the lamp stand out of its other side;
WEB.33: three cups made like almond blossoms in one branch, a bud and a flower; and three cups made like almond blossoms in the other branch, a bud and a flower, so for the six branches going out of the lamp stand;
WEB.34: and in the lamp stand four cups made like almond blossoms, its buds and its flowers;
WEB.35: and a bud under two branches of one piece with it, and a bud under two branches of one piece with it, and a bud under two branches of one piece with it, for the six branches going out of the lamp stand.
WEB.36: Their buds and their branches shall be of one piece with it, all of it one beaten work of pure gold.
WEB.37: You shall make its lamps seven, and they shall light its lamps to give light to the space in front of it.
WEB.38: Its snuffers and its snuff dishes shall be of pure gold.
WEB.39: It shall be made of a talent  of pure gold, with all these accessories.
WEB.40: See that you make them after their pattern, which has been shown to you on the mountain.

NLT.2: “Tell the people of Israel to bring me their sacred offerings. Accept the contributions from all whose hearts are moved to offer them.
NLT.3: Here is a list of sacred offerings you may accept from them: gold, silver, and bronze;
NLT.4:
blue, purple, and scarlet thread;
fine linen and goat hair for cloth;
NLT.5:
tanned ram skins and fine goatskin leather;
acacia wood;
NLT.6:
olive oil for the lamps;
spices for the anointing oil and the fragrant incense;
NLT.7: onyx stones, and other gemstones to be set in the ephod and the priest’s chestpiece.
NLT.8: “Have the people of Israel build me a holy sanctuary so I can live among them.
NLT.9: You must build this Tabernacle and its furnishings exactly according to the pattern I will show you.
NLT.10: “Have the people make an Ark of acacia wood — a sacred chest 45 inches long, 27 inches wide, and 27 inches high.
NLT.11: Overlay it inside and outside with pure gold, and run a molding of gold all around it.
NLT.12: Cast four gold rings and attach them to its four feet, two rings on each side.
NLT.13: Make poles from acacia wood, and overlay them with gold.
NLT.14: Insert the poles into the rings at the sides of the Ark to carry it.
NLT.15: These carrying poles must stay inside the rings; never remove them.
NLT.16: When the Ark is finished, place inside it the stone tablets inscribed with the terms of the covenant, which I will give to you.
NLT.17: “Then make the Ark’s cover — the place of atonement — from pure gold. It must be 45 inches long and 27 inches wide.
NLT.18: Then make two cherubim from hammered gold, and place them on the two ends of the atonement cover.
NLT.19: Mold the cherubim on each end of the atonement cover, making it all of one piece of gold.
NLT.20: The cherubim will face each other and look down on the atonement cover. With their wings spread above it, they will protect it.
NLT.21: Place inside the Ark the stone tablets inscribed with the terms of the covenant, which I will give to you. Then put the atonement cover on top of the Ark.
NLT.22: I will meet with you there and talk to you from above the atonement cover between the gold cherubim that hover over the Ark of the Covenant. From there I will give you my commands for the people of Israel.
NLT.23: “Then make a table of acacia wood, 36 inches long, 18 inches wide, and 27 inches high.
NLT.24: Overlay it with pure gold and run a gold molding around the edge.
NLT.25: Decorate it with a 3-inch border all around, and run a gold molding along the border.
NLT.26: Make four gold rings for the table and attach them at the four corners next to the four legs.
NLT.27: Attach the rings near the border to hold the poles that are used to carry the table.
NLT.28: Make these poles from acacia wood, and overlay them with gold.
NLT.29: Make special containers of pure gold for the table — bowls, ladles, pitchers, and jars — to be used in pouring out liquid offerings.
NLT.30: Place the Bread of the Presence on the table to remain before me at all times.
NLT.31: “Make a lampstand of pure, hammered gold. Make the entire lampstand and its decorations of one piece — the base, center stem, lamp cups, buds, and petals.
NLT.32: Make it with six branches going out from the center stem, three on each side.
NLT.33: Each of the six branches will have three lamp cups shaped like almond blossoms, complete with buds and petals.
NLT.34: Craft the center stem of the lampstand with four lamp cups shaped like almond blossoms, complete with buds and petals.
NLT.35: There will also be an almond bud beneath each pair of branches where the six branches extend from the center stem.
NLT.36: The almond buds and branches must all be of one piece with the center stem, and they must be hammered from pure gold.
NLT.37: Then make the seven lamps for the lampstand, and set them so they reflect their light forward.
NLT.38: The lamp snuffers and trays must also be made of pure gold.
NLT.39: You will need 75 pounds of pure gold for the lampstand and its accessories.
NLT.40: “Be sure that you make everything according to the pattern I have shown you here on the mountain.

CSB17.2: “Tell the Israelites to take an offering for me. You are to take my offering from everyone who is willing to give. <sup>ⓝ</sup>
CSB17.3: This is the offering you are to receive from them: gold, silver, and bronze;
CSB17.4: blue, purple, and scarlet yarn; fine linen and goat hair;
CSB17.5: ram skins dyed red <sup>ⓐ</sup> and fine leather; <sup>[1]</sup> acacia wood;
CSB17.6: oil <sup>ⓑ</sup> for the light; spices for the anointing oil and for the fragrant incense;
CSB17.7: and onyx <sup>[2]</sup> along with other gemstones for mounting on the ephod and breastpiece. <sup>[3]</sup> <sup>ⓒ</sup>
CSB17.8: “They are to make a sanctuary <sup>ⓓ</sup> for me so that I may dwell <sup>ⓔ</sup> among them.
CSB17.9: You must make it according to all that I show you — the pattern <sup>ⓕ</sup> of the tabernacle as well as the pattern of all its furnishings.
CSB17.10: “They are to make an ark <sup>ⓖ</sup> of acacia wood, forty-five inches long, twenty-seven inches wide, and twenty-seven inches high. <sup>[4]</sup>
CSB17.11: Overlay it with pure gold; overlay it both inside and out. Also make a gold molding all around it.
CSB17.12: Cast four gold rings for it and place them on its four feet, two rings on one side and two rings on the other side.
CSB17.13: Make poles of acacia wood and overlay them with gold.
CSB17.14: Insert the poles into the rings on the sides of the ark in order to carry the ark with them.
CSB17.15: The poles are to remain in the rings of the ark; they must not be removed from it.
CSB17.16: Put the tablets of <sup>[5]</sup> the testimony that I will give you into the ark. <sup>ⓗ</sup>
CSB17.17: Make a mercy seat <sup>ⓘ</sup> of pure gold, forty-five inches long and twenty-seven inches wide. <sup>[6]</sup>
CSB17.18: Make two cherubim of gold; make them of hammered work at the two ends of the mercy seat.
CSB17.19: Make one cherub at one end and one cherub at the other end. At its two ends, make the cherubim of one piece with the mercy seat.
CSB17.20: The cherubim are to have wings spread out above, covering <sup>ⓙ</sup> the mercy seat with their wings, and are to face one another. The faces of the cherubim should be toward the mercy seat.
CSB17.21: Set the mercy seat on top of the ark and put the tablets of the testimony that I will give you into the ark. <sup>ⓚ</sup>
CSB17.22: I will meet with you there above the mercy seat, between the two cherubim <sup>ⓛ</sup> that are over the ark of the testimony; I will speak with you from there about all that I command you regarding the Israelites.
CSB17.23: “You are to construct a table <sup>ⓜ</sup> of acacia wood, thirty-six inches long, eighteen inches wide, and twenty-seven inches high. <sup>[7]</sup>
CSB17.24: Overlay it with pure gold and make a gold molding all around it.
CSB17.25: Make a three-inch <sup>[8]</sup> frame all around it and make a gold molding for it all around its frame.
CSB17.26: Make four gold rings for it, and attach the rings to the four corners at its four legs.
CSB17.27: The rings should be next to the frame as holders for the poles to carry the table.
CSB17.28: Make the poles of acacia wood and overlay them with gold, and the table can be carried by them.
CSB17.29: You are also to make its plates <sup>ⓝ</sup> and cups, as well as its pitchers and bowls for pouring drink offerings. Make them out of pure gold.
CSB17.30: Put the Bread of the Presence <sup>ⓐ</sup> on the table before me at all times.
CSB17.31: “You <sup>ⓑ</sup> are to make a lampstand <sup>ⓒ</sup> out of pure, hammered gold. It is to be made of one piece: its base and shaft, its ornamental cups, and its buds <sup>[9]</sup> and petals.
CSB17.32: Six branches are to extend from its sides, three branches of the lampstand from one side and three branches of the lampstand from the other side.
CSB17.33: There are to be three cups shaped like almond blossoms, each with a bud and petals, on one branch, and three cups shaped like almond blossoms, each with a bud and petals, on the next branch. It is to be this way for the six branches that extend from the lampstand.
CSB17.34: There are to be four cups shaped like almond blossoms on the lampstand shaft along with its buds and petals.
CSB17.35: For the six branches that extend from the lampstand, a bud must be under the first pair of branches from it, a bud under the second pair of branches from it, and a bud under the third pair of branches from it.
CSB17.36: Their buds and branches are to be of one piece. <sup>[10]</sup> All of it is to be a single hammered piece of pure gold.
CSB17.37: “Make its seven lamps, <sup>ⓓ</sup> and set them up so that they illuminate the area in front of it.
CSB17.38: Its snuffers and firepans must be of pure gold.
CSB17.39: The lampstand <sup>[11]</sup> with all these utensils is to be made from seventy-five pounds <sup>[12]</sup> of pure gold.
CSB17.40: Be careful to make them according to the pattern <sup>ⓔ</sup> you have been shown on the mountain.

AMP.1: Then the LORD spoke to Moses, saying,
AMP.2: "Tell the children of Israel to take an offering for Me. From every man whose heart moves him [to give willingly] you shall take My offering.
AMP.3: This is the offering you are to receive from them: gold, silver, and bronze,
AMP.4: blue, purple, and scarlet fabric, fine twisted linen, goats' hair,
AMP.5: rams' skins dyed red, porpoise skins, acacia wood,
AMP.6: [olive] oil for lighting, balsam for the anointing oil and for the fragrant incense,
AMP.7: onyx stones and setting stones for the [priest's] ephod and for the breastpiece.
AMP.8: Have them build a sanctuary for Me, so that I may dwell among them.
AMP.9: You shall construct it in accordance with everything that I am going to show you, as the pattern of the tabernacle and the pattern of all its furniture.
AMP.10: "They shall make an ark of acacia wood two and a half cubits long, one and a half cubits wide, and one and a half cubits high.
AMP.11: You shall overlay the ark with pure gold, overlay it inside and out, and you shall make a gold border (frame) around its top.
AMP.12: You shall cast four gold rings for it and attach them to the four feet, two rings on either side.
AMP.13: You shall make [carrying] poles of acacia wood and overlay them with gold,
AMP.14: and put the poles through the rings on the sides of the ark, by which to carry it.
AMP.15: The poles shall remain in the rings of the ark; they shall not be removed from it [so that the ark itself need not be touched].
AMP.16: You shall put into the ark the Testimony (Ten Commandments) which I will give you.
AMP.17: "You shall make a mercy seat (cover) of pure gold, two and a half cubits long and one and a half cubits wide.
AMP.18: You shall make two cherubim (winged angelic figures) of [solid] hammered gold at the two ends of the mercy seat.
AMP.19: Make one cherub at each end, making the cherubim of one piece with the mercy seat at its two ends.
AMP.20: The cherubim shall have their wings spread upward, covering the mercy seat with their wings and facing each other. The faces of the cherubim are to be looking downward toward the mercy seat.
AMP.21: You shall put the mercy seat on the top of the ark, and in the ark you shall put the Testimony which I will give you.
AMP.22: There I will meet with you; from above the mercy seat, from between the two cherubim which are on the ark of the Testimony, I will speak [intimately] with you regarding every commandment that I will give you for the Israelites.
AMP.23: "You shall make a table of acacia wood, two cubits long, one cubit wide, and one and a half cubits high.
AMP.24: You shall overlay it with pure gold and make a border of gold around the top of it.
AMP.25: You shall make a rim of a hand width around it; you shall make a gold border for the rim around it.
AMP.26: You shall make four gold rings for it and fasten them at the four corners that are on the table's four legs.
AMP.27: The rings shall be close against the rim as holders for the poles to carry the table.
AMP.28: You shall make the poles of acacia wood and overlay them with gold, so that the table may be carried with them.
AMP.29: You shall make its plates [for the showbread] and its cups [for incense] and its pitchers and bowls for sacrificial drink offerings; you shall make them of pure gold.
AMP.30: You shall set the bread of the Presence (showbread) on the table before Me at all times.
AMP.31: "You shall make a lampstand of pure gold. The lampstand and its base and its shaft shall be made of hammered work; its cups, its calyxes and its flowers shall be all of one piece with it.
AMP.32: Six branches shall come out of its sides; three branches of the lampstand out of the one side and three branches of the lampstand out of its other side [the shaft being the seventh branch].
AMP.33: Three cups shall be made like almond blossoms, each with a calyx and a flower on one branch, and three cups made like almond blossoms on the other branch with a calyx and a flower—so for the six branches coming out of the lampstand;
AMP.34: and in the [center shaft of the] lampstand [you shall make] four cups shaped like almond blossoms, with their calyxes and their flowers.
AMP.35: A calyx shall be under the first pair of branches coming out of it, and a calyx under the second pair of branches coming out of it, and a calyx under the third pair of branches coming out of it, for the six branches coming out of the lampstand.
AMP.36: Their calyxes and their branches shall be of one piece with it; all of it shall be one piece of hammered work of pure gold.
AMP.37: Then you shall make the lamps [of the lampstand] seven in number [with one lamp at the top of the shaft]. The priests shall set up its seven lamps so that they will light the space in front of it.
AMP.38: Its snuffers and their trays shall be of pure gold.
AMP.39: It shall be made from a talent (50-80 lbs.) of pure gold, including all these utensils.
AMP.40: See that you make them [exactly] after their pattern which was shown to you on the mountain.

NIV.1:
Offerings for the Tabernacle
The Lord said to Moses,
NIV.2: “Tell the Israelites to bring me an offering. You are to receive the offering for me from each man whose heart prompts him to give.
NIV.3: These are the offerings you are to receive from them: gold, silver and bronze;
NIV.4: blue, purple and scarlet yarn and fine linen; goat hair;
NIV.5: ram skins dyed red and hides of sea cows; acacia wood;
NIV.6: olive oil for the light; spices for the anointing oil and for the fragrant incense;
NIV.7: and onyx stones and other gems to be mounted on the ephod and breastpiece.
NIV.8: “Then have them make a sanctuary for me, and I will dwell among them.
NIV.9: Make this tabernacle and all its furnishings exactly like the pattern I will show you.
NIV.10:
The Ark
“Have them make a chest of acacia wood—two and a half cubits long, a cubit and a half wide, and a cubit and a half high.
NIV.11: Overlay it with pure gold, both inside and out, and make a gold molding around it.
NIV.12: Cast four gold rings for it and fasten them to its four feet, with two rings on one side and two rings on the other.
NIV.13: Then make poles of acacia wood and overlay them with gold.
NIV.14: Insert the poles into the rings on the sides of the chest to carry it.
NIV.15: The poles are to remain in the rings of this ark; they are not to be removed.
NIV.16: Then put in the ark the Testimony, which I will give you.
NIV.17: “Make an atonement cover of pure gold—two and a half cubits long and a cubit and a half wide.
NIV.18: And make two cherubim out of hammered gold at the ends of the cover.
NIV.19: Make one cherub on one end and the second cherub on the other; make the cherubim of one piece with the cover, at the two ends.
NIV.20: The cherubim are to have their wings spread upward, overshadowing the cover with them. The cherubim are to face each other, looking toward the cover.
NIV.21: Place the cover on top of the ark and put in the ark the Testimony, which I will give you.
NIV.22: There, above the cover between the two cherubim that are over the ark of the Testimony, I will meet with you and give you all my commands for the Israelites.
NIV.23:
The Table
“Make a table of acacia wood—two cubits long, a cubit wide and a cubit and a half high.
NIV.24: Overlay it with pure gold and make a gold molding around it.
NIV.25: Also make around it a rim a handbreadth wide and put a gold molding on the rim.
NIV.26: Make four gold rings for the table and fasten them to the four corners, where the four legs are.
NIV.27: The rings are to be close to the rim to hold the poles used in carrying the table.
NIV.28: Make the poles of acacia wood, overlay them with gold and carry the table with them.
NIV.29: And make its plates and dishes of pure gold, as well as its pitchers and bowls for the pouring out of offerings.
NIV.30: Put the bread of the Presence on this table to be before me at all times.
NIV.31:
The Lampstand
“Make a lampstand of pure gold and hammer it out, base and shaft; its flowerlike cups, buds and blossoms shall be of one piece with it.
NIV.32: Six branches are to extend from the sides of the lampstand—three on one side and three on the other.
NIV.33: Three cups shaped like almond flowers with buds and blossoms are to be on one branch, three on the next branch, and the same for all six branches extending from the lampstand.
NIV.34: And on the lampstand there are to be four cups shaped like almond flowers with buds and blossoms.
NIV.35: One bud shall be under the first pair of branches extending from the lampstand, a second bud under the second pair, and a third bud under the third pair—six branches in all.
NIV.36: The buds and branches shall all be of one piece with the lampstand, hammered out of pure gold.
NIV.37: “Then make its seven lamps and set them up on it so that they light the space in front of it.
NIV.38: Its wick trimmers and trays are to be of pure gold.
NIV.39: A talent of pure gold is to be used for the lampstand and all these accessories.
NIV.40: See that you make them according to the pattern shown you on the mountain.

MSG.2: "Tell the Israelites that they are to set aside offerings for me. Receive the offerings from everyone who is willing to give.

MSG.4: blue, purple, and scarlet material; fine linen; goats' hair;
MSG.5: tanned rams' skins; dolphin skins; acacia wood;
MSG.6: lamp oil; spices for anointing oils and for fragrant incense;
MSG.7: onyx stones and other stones for setting in the Ephod and the Breastpiece.

MSG.14: and insert them into the rings on the sides of the Chest for carrying the Chest.

NET.7: onyx stones, and other gems to be set in the ephod and in the breastpiece.
NET.8: Let them make for me a sanctuary, so that I may live among them.
NET.9: According to all that I am showing you — the pattern of the tabernacle and the pattern of all its furnishings — you must make it exactly so.
NET.10: “They are to make an ark of acacia wood — its length is to be three feet nine inches, its width two feet three inches, and its height two feet three inches.
NET.11: You are to overlay it with pure gold — both inside and outside you must overlay it, and you are to make a surrounding border of gold over it.
NET.12: You are to cast four gold rings for it and put them on its four feet, with two rings on one side and two rings on the other side.
NET.13: You are to make poles of acacia wood, overlay them with gold,
NET.14: and put the poles into the rings at the sides of the ark in order to carry the ark with them.
NET.15: The poles must remain in the rings of the ark; they must not be removed from it.
NET.16: You are to put into the ark the testimony that I will give to you.
NET.17: “You are to make an atonement lid of pure gold; its length is to be three feet nine inches, and its width is to be two feet three inches.
NET.18: You are to make two cherubim of gold; you are to make them of hammered metal on the two ends of the atonement lid.
NET.19: Make one cherub on one end and one cherub on the other end; from the atonement lid you are to make the cherubim on the two ends.
NET.20: The cherubim are to be spreading their wings upward, overshadowing the atonement lid with their wings, and the cherubim are to face each other, looking toward the atonement lid.
NET.21: You are to put the atonement lid on top of the ark, and in the ark you are to put the testimony I am giving you.
NET.22: I will meet with you there, and from above the atonement lid, from between the two cherubim that are over the ark of the testimony, I will speak with you about all that I will command you for the Israelites.
NET.23: “You are to make a table of acacia wood; its length is to be three feet, its width one foot six inches, and its height two feet three inches.
NET.24: You are to overlay it with pure gold, and you are to make a surrounding border of gold for it.
NET.25: You are to make a surrounding frame for it about three inches broad, and you are to make a surrounding border of gold for its frame.
NET.26: You are to make four rings of gold for it and attach the rings at the four corners where its four legs are.
NET.27: The rings are to be close to the frame to provide places for the poles to carry the table.
NET.28: You are to make the poles of acacia wood and overlay them with gold, so that the table may be carried with them.
NET.29: You are to make its plates, its ladles, its pitchers, and its bowls, to be used in pouring out offerings; you are to make them of pure gold.
NET.30: You are to set the Bread of the Presence on the table before me continually.
NET.31: “You are to make a lampstand of pure gold. The lampstand is to be made of hammered metal; its base and its shaft, its cups, its buds, and its blossoms are to be from the same piece.
NET.32: Six branches are to extend from the sides of the lampstand, three branches of the lampstand from one side of it and three branches of the lampstand from the other side of it.
NET.33: Three cups shaped like almond flowers with buds and blossoms are to be on one branch, and three cups shaped like almond flowers with buds and blossoms are to be on the next branch, and the same for the six branches extending from the lampstand.
NET.34: On the lampstand there are to be four cups shaped like almond flowers with buds and blossoms,
NET.35: with a bud under the first two branches from it, and a bud under the next two branches from it, and a bud under the third two branches from it, according to the six branches that extend from the lampstand.
NET.36: Their buds and their branches will be one piece, all of it one hammered piece of pure gold.
NET.37: “You are to make its seven lamps, and then set its lamps up on it, so that it will give light to the area in front of it.
NET.38: Its trimmers and its trays are to be of pure gold.
NET.39: About seventy-five pounds of pure gold is to be used for it and for all these utensils.
NET.40: Now be sure to make them according to the pattern you were shown on the mountain.

NRSVCE.2: Tell the Israelites to take for me an offering; from all whose hearts prompt them to give you shall receive the offering for me.
NRSVCE.3: This is the offering that you shall receive from them: gold, silver, and bronze,
NRSVCE.4: blue, purple, and crimson yarns and fine linen, goats’ hair,
NRSVCE.5: tanned rams’ skins, fine leather, acacia wood,
NRSVCE.6: oil for the lamps, spices for the anointing oil and for the fragrant incense,
NRSVCE.7: onyx stones and gems to be set in the ephod and for the breastpiece.
NRSVCE.8: And have them make me a sanctuary, so that I may dwell among them.
NRSVCE.9: In accordance with all that I show you concerning the pattern of the tabernacle and of all its furniture, so you shall make it.
NRSVCE.10: They shall make an ark of acacia wood; it shall be two and a half cubits long, a cubit and a half wide, and a cubit and a half high.
NRSVCE.11: You shall overlay it with pure gold, inside and outside you shall overlay it, and you shall make a molding of gold upon it all around.
NRSVCE.12: You shall cast four rings of gold for it and put them on its four feet, two rings on the one side of it, and two rings on the other side.
NRSVCE.13: You shall make poles of acacia wood, and overlay them with gold.
NRSVCE.14: And you shall put the poles into the rings on the sides of the ark, by which to carry the ark.
NRSVCE.15: The poles shall remain in the rings of the ark; they shall not be taken from it.
NRSVCE.16: You shall put into the ark the covenant that I shall give you.
NRSVCE.17: Then you shall make a mercy seat of pure gold; two cubits and a half shall be its length, and a cubit and a half its width.
NRSVCE.18: You shall make two cherubim of gold; you shall make them of hammered work, at the two ends of the mercy seat.
NRSVCE.19: Make one cherub at the one end, and one cherub at the other; of one piece with the mercy seat you shall make the cherubim at its two ends.
NRSVCE.20: The cherubim shall spread out their wings above, overshadowing the mercy seat with their wings. They shall face one to another; the faces of the cherubim shall be turned toward the mercy seat.
NRSVCE.21: You shall put the mercy seat on the top of the ark; and in the ark you shall put the covenant that I shall give you.
NRSVCE.22: There I will meet with you, and from above the mercy seat, from between the two cherubim that are on the ark of the covenant, I will deliver to you all my commands for the Israelites.
NRSVCE.23: You shall make a table of acacia wood, two cubits long, one cubit wide, and a cubit and a half high.
NRSVCE.24: You shall overlay it with pure gold, and make a molding of gold around it.
NRSVCE.25: You shall make around it a rim a handbreadth wide, and a molding of gold around the rim.
NRSVCE.26: You shall make for it four rings of gold, and fasten the rings to the four corners at its four legs.
NRSVCE.27: The rings that hold the poles used for carrying the table shall be close to the rim.
NRSVCE.28: You shall make the poles of acacia wood, and overlay them with gold, and the table shall be carried with these.
NRSVCE.29: You shall make its plates and dishes for incense, and its flagons and bowls with which to pour drink offerings; you shall make them of pure gold.
NRSVCE.30: And you shall set the bread of the Presence on the table before me always.
NRSVCE.31: You shall make a lampstand of pure gold. The base and the shaft of the lampstand shall be made of hammered work; its cups, its calyxes, and its petals shall be of one piece with it;
NRSVCE.32: and there shall be six branches going out of its sides, three branches of the lampstand out of one side of it and three branches of the lampstand out of the other side of it;
NRSVCE.33: three cups shaped like almond blossoms, each with calyx and petals, on one branch, and three cups shaped like almond blossoms, each with calyx and petals, on the other branch — so for the six branches going out of the lampstand.
NRSVCE.34: On the lampstand itself there shall be four cups shaped like almond blossoms, each with its calyxes and petals.
NRSVCE.35: There shall be a calyx of one piece with it under the first pair of branches, a calyx of one piece with it under the next pair of branches, and a calyx of one piece with it under the last pair of branches — so for the six branches that go out of the lampstand.
NRSVCE.36: Their calyxes and their branches shall be of one piece with it, the whole of it one hammered piece of pure gold.
NRSVCE.37: You shall make the seven lamps for it; and the lamps shall be set up so as to give light on the space in front of it.
NRSVCE.38: Its snuffers and trays shall be of pure gold.
NRSVCE.39: It, and all these utensils, shall be made from a talent of pure gold.
NRSVCE.40: And see that you make them according to the pattern for them, which is being shown you on the mountain.
